name: NATRIUM PHOSPHORICUM
key_symptoms: Sour eructations, sour vomiting, greenish diarrhśa. Spits mouthful of food.
Feels dull in the morning, full feeling and throbbing.
Weariness; aching in wrists and finger-joints. Hamstrings sore. Synovial crepitation. Rheumatic arthritis.
guiding_symptoms: Sour eructations, sour vomiting, greenish diarrhśa. Spits mouthful of food.
Feels dull in the morning, full feeling and throbbing.
mind_symptoms: Imagines, on waking at night, that pieces of furniture are persons; that the hears footsteps in next room. Fear.
head_symptoms: Feels dull in the morning, full feeling and throbbing.
gi_symptoms: Sour eructations, sour vomiting, greenish diarrhśa. Spits mouthful of food.
urinary_symptoms: Emissions without dreams, with weakness in back and trembling in limbs. Desire without erection. Gonorrhśa.
skin_symptoms: Yellow. Itching in various parts, especially of ankles. Hives. Smooth, red, shining. Erysipelas. Feet icy cold in daytime, burn at night. Swelling of lymphatic glands.

source.title: NATRIUM PHOSPHORICUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
